Each signed receipt was checked canonical at capture, then its branch was reverted to preserve the selected source state. These historical experiment receipts are not simultaneously surviving final-chain receipts. One selected claim used 492544 gas at both populations; eight used 1783679 at both populations. The one-step WeightedUnstake used 383019 gas. Fixture holder transactions are recorded separately and are not target-envelope evidence.
